Corner.Situation: Rapid typing inside a mermaid diagram block (30-char burst)
Corner.Expected: per-block trailing debounce collapses the burst into ONE render after ~250 ms quiet; the last good SVG stays visible during typing; no loading flash; no render after block deletion (pending cancelled)

Corner.Situation: Theme switch Paper → Ink (and Auto light/dark flip) with N rendered diagrams
Corner.Expected: ZERO pele render calls (BLOCK_PELE_RENDER does not fire) and ZERO cache misses — the byte-identical cached SVG is re-inserted; colors change through the --pele-* CSS cascade; cache key is code-only (no theme component)

Corner.Situation: Document with 20 mixed-type diagrams opened cold
Corner.Expected: all render sequentially and synchronously (0.05–12 ms each per spike), each with a unique idPrefix; no main-thread stall beyond one frame per batch; every type incl. bonus types (venn-beta, treemap, agentflow-beta) produces an SVG

Corner.Situation: Syntax error introduced mid-diagram (PeleError code syntax/semantic/limit)
Corner.Expected: keep-last-good SVG stays; a small error element below shows the escaped message via textContent only; fixing the code re-renders and removes the error element; no orphan scratch elements in body (pele is DOM-free — nothing to leak)

Corner.Situation: gantt / journey / packet / timeline diagrams wider than the column
Corner.Expected: natural width preserved with in-block horizontal scroll (per-type options: fontSize/maxWidth/padding re-expressing the C-51 lab look); labels render ≥ 11 px; every other type keeps fit-to-column responsive width

Corner.Situation: Editor font size zoom (C-49) with rendered diagrams
Corner.Expected: data-natural-width comes from RenderResult.width; inline max-width: calc(var(--mark-zoom, 1) × natural px) scales diagram + labels with the editor font; fullscreen viewer clone still overrides size from the viewBox

Corner.Situation: Export HTML / print of a document with diagrams
Corner.Expected: standalone file carries rendered pele SVGs + an inlined --pele-* variable block matching the exporting theme; no mermaid script/CDN references; sanitize path unchanged; the file renders correctly in a plain browser without app CSS

Corner.Situation: Hostile diagram source: labels with <script>/onload, javascript: links, data: URLs
Corner.Expected: pele escaping/stripping holds in BOTH editor and export (XSS probes green); no securityLevel config exists anymore because the engine is safe by construction

Corner.Situation: Block viewer (expand) on a pele diagram, then theme switch while open
Corner.Expected: clone renders at natural size from the viewBox; being a var() consumer it recolors with the theme like the inline preview; the poll/swap logic is not triggered by a pure theme switch (content unchanged)

Corner.Situation: Tab close / editor teardown with debounced renders and cached SVGs in flight
Corner.Expected: flushPending cancels timers; caches and last-good maps cleared; no late insert into a detached DOM; ResizeObserver entries released via the existing expand-need unobserve path
PeleError code 'limit' surfaces through the same keep-last-good UX as a syntax error (no freeze, no crash); the error text names the limit
zero mermaid chunks in dist/assets (were 44 / 2.6 MB raw); one pele chunk (~251 KB gzip full bundle); node_modules without mermaid (75 MB gone); app cold start unaffected or better
